description: '?' on an operand one opcode-set member declares required: 'mean' is optional in batchnorm_bwd and required by batchnorm_inference. The '?' check runs per member before the members are compared, so it fails rather than the disagreement.
runtime_error: operand 'mean' of opcode 'batchnorm_inference' is required, so binding '$mean?' cannot be optional
packager_error: operand 'mean' is bound with '?', but the registry declares it required in op 'batchnorm_inference'
